posts.headline: StrategyDynamics 2.0 is live.
posts.sub: Rebuilt from the ground up. On iPhone and the web, one account. From £9.99 a month.

posts.angle: Launch day. StrategyDynamics 2.0 is a full rebuild, live today on iPhone and the web.
